newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKOBANK ITSELF SEEN BEHIND BIG YIT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: OKOBANK ITSELF SEEN BEHIND BIG YIT DEAL.

text.p: OKOBANK was probably reorganising its holdings in building group YIT-Yhtyma in the large in-house transaction by OKOBANK's brokerage Opstock on Thursday morning, an industry source said.
Opstock made an in-house deal of 841,450 shares at 1036/0736 GMT at 49.00 markka each, up 0.50 markka, but declined to comment. OKOBANK officials also declined to comment.
"The amount is equal to Op Osake Oy's holding, I would say it is quite possible they have done something," the source said, requesting anonymity.
An OKOBANK spokesman said Op Osake Oy's activities have been transferred to Op Rahastoyhtio Oy which runs the group's mutual funds.
Of the other owners large enough to have sold that big a stake, Pohjola and Merita said they had not sold shares. At Tapiola and Rautaruukki, nobody was available for comment.
An YIT official declined to comment.
